digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI pytest matrix / reusable workflow timeout
propositions: GitHub Actions Gerrit Verified Gate pytest matrix jobs advance to 99% then emit nothing for hours until manually cancelled.
Affected stale Gerrit patchsets omit fix commit 96a0d5c3f and retain unbounded per-blob lazy git fetch under blobless partial clone, hanging materialization.
The reusable workflow test job lacks timeout-minutes, so hung runs persist to GitHub's 360-minute default and require manual clearing.
A separate paging defect makes get_comment_map loop indefinitely because FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignores startAt/maxResults and never returns an empty terminal page.
Comparable fixed-ancestry runs complete the default suite in minutes, confirming hours-long behavior is a defect not legitimate test cost.
Fixes bound jobs.test at timeout-minutes: 60 and slice the fake pager, each proven via RED/GREEN/mutation regression oracles.
